description: Normalize and canonicalize all user-supplied structured input (URLs, IP addresses, domain names, file paths, type identifiers, protocol schemes) to a standard form before applying any security decision such as allowlist matching, denylist checking, or policy evaluation. Decoding, case folding, Unicode normalization, IP address format unification (dotted-decimal, hex, octal, IPv4-mapped IPv6), and scheme normalization must occur before the security check — not after. This prevents attackers from using encoding variants, aliasing, or alternate representations to bypass list-based security controls. The canonicalization order must be: decode all layers → normalize → validate against security policy → sanitize.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: The attacker must find an input representation that survives full canonicalization while still bypassing the security check — encoding tricks (URL-encoding, Unicode homoglyphs, octal IP notation, mixed-case evasion) are neutralized before the security decision is made, requiring the attacker to discover a novel bypass that operates at the semantic level rather than the syntactic level

verification.method: Review application source code for canonicalization/normalization calls that execute before security-relevant comparisons (allowlist checks, denylist checks, policy evaluations). Verify that the canonicalized form — not the raw input — is used in all subsequent security decisions.

commands.expected: Canonicalization/normalization calls present in input-handling code paths that feed into security decisions
Zero matches — security list checks should operate on canonicalized values, not raw request parameters
Both requests return identical response codes (both blocked or both canonicalized and rejected)

remediation.name: nginx URL canonicalization and encoded-path normalization

steps.description: Create an nginx config snippet that enables merge_slashes (collapses // to /), and adds a rewrite rule to reject requests containing percent-encoded path separators (%2f, %2e) that could bypass path-based security checks
Test nginx configuration for syntax errors
Reload nginx to apply the canonicalization rules

remediation.name: Apache httpd URL decoding enforcement and path traversal blocking

steps.description: Create an Apache config snippet that denies AllowEncodedSlashes (forces URL decoding before path matching) and adds a mod_rewrite rule to block double-encoded traversal attempts
steps.command:
printf '<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  # Block percent-encoded path traversal sequences
  RewriteCond %%{THE_REQUEST} %%2[eE]%%2[eE] [OR]
  RewriteCond %%{THE_REQUEST} %%2[fF]
  RewriteRule .* - [F,L]
</IfModule>
AllowEncodedSlashes NoDecode
' > /etc/httpd/conf.d/cme-1314-canonicalization.conf

steps.description: Test Apache configuration for syntax errors
Reload Apache to apply the canonicalization rules
steps.command: systemctl reload httpd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload apache2 2>/dev/null
